discussion_comments.comment_body: Fixed in 0b6e96f80b. `factsOf` now reads only the messages after the newest real prompt (a user message whose `userRunSpan` isn't 0), so an earlier turn's edits or errors no longer drive Verify, Review or Fix; reminders, hook context and steering that core injects mid-run carry `userRunSpan: 0` and stay inside the turn.

Intentional tradeoff. A cut-off stream whose last 2k non-whitespace chars are pure 0/1 is rare, and it fails with a clear error rather than stopping silently. Loosening the check to allow it would weaken detection of the real repetition-loop case, so leaving it as is.

I’ll add support for that nested field and a positive-reasoning regression test.

discussion_comments.comment_body: Pushed in 4a4844d6e8 — added `["outputTokens", "reasoning"]` to `REASONING_TOKEN_PATHS` and a regression test (`subtracts AI SDK v4's nested outputTokens.reasoning from outputTokens`) covering this exact shape. Full `llms` suite still green (886 passed).

Valid — fixed, test-first: both `stop` and `max-tokens` empty retries reproduced exactly this (`Model returned empty response`, truncated turn gone). An empty retry is no more a replacement than an aborted or errored one, so it now keeps the truncated turn and lets the loop surface the max-tokens error, matching the nothing-to-compact path. Also added a table-driven test over the full retry-outcome matrix (every finish reason × text / tool call / empty / provider-executed activity) asserting the partial answer is never silently dropped and the loop is never handed an empty turn — all 20 cells pass.

**[P2] Preserve completed provider-tool activity.** Provider-executed tools live in `metadata.modelToolActivities`, so this condition also matches a retry that executes a provider tool, emits text, then errors. Recording only `first` discards the completed tool result from conversation history. Please preserve the retry's completed activity as well.

Fixed — request preparation is now split from issuing, and recovery prepares the compacted request once, then re-issues it under the shared bounded provider-retry policy. Compaction (notices, telemetry, summarizer) runs once regardless of retries; exhaustion surfaces the provider error with the truncated turn kept. Tests cover the recovered case (exactly one overflowRecovery prepare, same compacted messages each attempt) and exhaustion.
